---
title: "Garlic Butter Salmon"
description: Fifteen minutes, one pan, and the sauce makes itself.
categories: [dinner, quick, one-pan, fish]
time: 20 min
servings: 2
---

## Ingredients

- 2 salmon fillets, skin on
- 1 tbsp olive oil
- 30 g butter
- 3 cloves garlic, sliced
- 1 lemon
- A handful of dill, chopped
- Salt
- Black pepper

## Method

1. Pat the salmon dry and season both sides. Dry skin is the difference between crisp and rubbery.
2. Heat the oil in a non-stick pan over medium-high. Lay the fillets in skin down, pressing each one flat for 10 seconds.
3. Cook undisturbed for 5–6 minutes, until the flesh has turned opaque two-thirds of the way up the side.
4. Flip, drop in the butter and garlic, and cook 2 minutes more, spooning the foaming butter over the fish.
5. Off the heat, squeeze in half the lemon and scatter with dill. Spoon the pan butter over to serve.
